messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
typedef unsigned long long ull;

ll read() {
    char ch = getchar();
    ll x = 0, f = 1;
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') f = -1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    x = ch - '0';
    while (1) {
        ch = getchar();
        if (ch < '0' || ch > '9') break;
        x = x * 10 + ch - '0';
    }
    return x * f;
}

const ll MOD = 1000000007;

ll mul_mod(ll a, ll b, ll mod) {
    ll res = 0;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = (res + a) % mod;
        b >>= 1;
        a = (a + a) % mod;
    }
    return res;
}

ll pow_mod(ll base, ll exp, ll mod) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (exp) {
        if (exp & 1) res = mul_mod(res, base, mod);
        exp >>= 1;
        base = mul_mod(base, base, mod);
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ll p = read(), k = read();
    ll result;
    if (k == 0) {
        result = pow_mod(p, p - 1, MOD);
    } else if (k == 1) {
        result = pow_mod(p, p, MOD);
    } else {
        ll len = 1;
        ll cur = k % MOD;
        while (cur != 1) {
            cur = (cur * k) % MOD;
            ++len;
        }
        result = pow_mod(p, (p - 1) / len, MOD);
    }
    printf("%I64d\n", result);
    return 0;
}
